publication_scope: Sanitized measurements and private-evidence hashes only; no RTL, vendor reports, credentials or infrastructure details.

fit_backed_planning.qualification: Planning at80MHz below reported Fmax; no80MHz refit, board runtime or complete PRP benchmark. Same representative candidate and exponent-bit approximation as progress.json.

component_fits.qualification: Same initiation interval1 as retimed baseline;32 extra latency clocks and1606 more registers. Fmax ratio is not whole-core speedup.

prefetch_ntt16.qualification: Five NTT arithmetic phases only; excludes CRT/carry/host/profile upload and does not establish a whole-core win.

limitations: All physical results are standalone or whole-core virtual-I/O probes on a provisional Arria10 target, with reset false-pathed; not board sign-off.
Raw resources are distinct from packing-adjusted resource needs.
Report hashes identify private evidence but do not make the underlying RTL publicly reproducible.
Component Fmax cannot replace integrated-core timing in a candidate-throughput estimate.
